examples.japanese: ⟦{器具|きぐ}→器具：03980_kigu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{滅菌|めっきん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{哺乳|ほにゅう}{瓶|びん}→哺乳瓶：20671_honyuubin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{滅菌|めっきん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please sterilize baby bottles before use.

examples.japanese: {手術室|しゅじゅつしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厳密|げんみつ}→厳密：11885_genmitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{滅菌|めっきん}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: All instruments in the operating room are rigorously sterilized.

notes:
Refers to the complete destruction of all microorganisms including bacteria, viruses, and spores. Stricter than ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧ (disinfection), which only reduces the number of pathogens.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {滅菌|めっきん}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧: sterilization treatment
- {滅菌|めっきん}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: sterilized (done)
- ⟦{高圧|こうあつ}→高圧：21094_kouatsu⟧{滅菌|めっきん}: autoclave sterilization
- {滅菌|めっきん}⟦ガーゼ→ガーゼ：28833_gaaze⟧: sterile gauze

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{殺菌|さっきん}→殺菌：09781_sakkin⟧: disinfection, pasteurization — kills or reduces harmful bacteria but does not eliminate all microorganisms
- ⟦{消毒|しょうどく}→消毒：07591_shoudoku⟧: disinfection, sanitization — a broader term for cleaning to remove pathogens; used in everyday contexts like hand sanitizing
- ⟦{除菌|じょきん}→除菌：07789_jokin⟧: removing bacteria — commonly seen on household cleaning products; less technical than {滅菌|めっきん}
